summary: Every criterion was re-graded at 10ab04a under the current test-audit skill, which takes required parts from the PRD criteria and assumptions and uses the technical design only to find code. AC-SAFE-01, AC-SAFE-02, AC-SAFE-03 and AC-SAFE-04 are Adequate, with new tests seen failing except where the only break would widen a guard on what Start writes, launches or removes. Doug accepted the 14 rows still Weak on 2026-11-08 and closed the audit; each is recorded with its gap in the Accepted section of test-audit.md, and that decision includes the high-risk AC-GONE-01, AC-SETUP-04 and AC-SETUP-05. Doug's ruling on a pending pause was added to AC-SAFE-03 in the PRD: on an existing-branch start, the phase the run stopped on is still to run until its done check passes.
